components.name: threshold / negative Q(sqrt(-7)) sector
components.physical_role: negative-sector companion and QCD threshold field

electroweak_diagnostic.interpretation: q/Phi3 is the imbalance of the two Ramanujan/E6 compiler weights

theorem_statement: The 24:15 Ramanujan/E6 compiler split reduces to the Fibonacci mixer 8:5 with denominator 13=Phi3.  The successful QCD bare factor 24/13 is the q-generation lift of the carrier weight 8/13, while the companion threshold sector is the q-generation lift 15/13 of the threshold weight 5/13.  Their normalized imbalance is 3/13=q/Phi3.
interpretive_note: This turns the two-sector compiler into a mixing rule.  The shell does not merely contain dimensions 24 and 15; it normalizes them into the weights 8/13 and 5/13.  QCD uses the q-lifted carrier weight, while electroweak-like diagnostics naturally see the carrier-threshold imbalance q/Phi3.
